_readme: The 10 sample prompts of the 2026-11-23 Statekeeper audit (C:/repos/_handoffs/statekeeper-audit-20261123.md section 2), as a regression set for eval/run_eval.py. Ids are from the snapshot shadow-20261123-105033.db (a verified backup of the live store, kept outside git); run with --db pointing at it. Tune only against this set and eval/cases.json, never by feel. 'expect' is a list of groups (any id of a group satisfies it); 'stale' lists states that must NOT be injected.
